metadata.title: Chocolate Croissant Bread Pudding
metadata.description:
Listening to Jimmy Buffett while I cook is part time of my daily routine, so when I heard that the Margaritaville cookbook was getting released, I was so excited! Each page is filled with everyday recipes (Gazpacho video coming up next) but my favorite series far is definitely this rich bread pudding. 

This recipe is from my latest favorite cookbook “Margaritaville” check out the recipe here: https://coffeebreakxo.com/2018/06/09/chocolate-croissant-bread-pudding/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coffeebreakxo/

nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows how to make cr umbrella cake with ice cream and chocolate pieces.
The person in the video is showing how to make a dish by putting together bread, then putting into a casserole dish, and then adding an ice cream on top.
It is recorded by someone that is outdoors.

summary.brief: Chocolate croissant bread pudding is layered with chocolate and served with vanilla ice cream.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a collage of ingredient shots and text introducing chocolate croissant bread pudding. Fresh chocolate croissants are toasted until crisp while a custard is prepared by whisking together brown sugar, sweetened condensed milk, granulated sugar, half‑and‑half, 2 % milk and vanilla; the mixture is heated and the eggs are tempered in a little at a time. The warm custard is poured over the toasted croissant cubes placed in a rectangular baking dish, ensuring every piece is coated. Layers of chopped dark chocolate, chocolate chips and crushed chocolate cookies are sprinkled between the custard‑soaked croissants. The dish is baked at 300 °F for about 40 minutes, then allowed to cool briefly. A generous scoop of vanilla ice cream is placed on each serving, and the finished dessert is shown on a white plate against an outdoor background of grass and trees before ending with a promotional coffee‑and‑social‑media screen.

action.detailed: Toast the croissant pieces, whisk together milk, condensed milk, sugars, half‑and‑half, 2 % milk and vanilla, temper the eggs into the hot mixture, pour the custard over the toasted croissants in a baking dish, sprinkle chopped dark chocolate, chocolate chips and crushed cookies in layers, bake until set, then top each serving with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

nodes.plm_caption:
This video captures a sequence of someone making bread pudding. At the start the woman displays ingredients she will be using before cooking them all together. There are two bowls of sugar and a measuring cup filled with milk. She also includes a cup of liquid seasoning and a brown sugar. There is a pan on the stove which the milk, seasoning and sugar will be being cooked in. Then she proceeds to add the cubed bread on top of the mixture in the pan.

This video is short and compact and well lit. The camera work is of high quality and clearly makes out the textures of the bread and the ingredients in the dish.

summary.brief: The host toasts croissant pieces, makes a vanilla‑flavored custard, and coats the toasted cubes with it to form chocolate croissant bread pudding.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with title cards that read “CHOCOLATE CROISSANT” and “BREAD PUDDING,” followed by quick clips of coffee, a scoop of vanilla ice‑cream and toasted croissant slices. The host then displays several clear bowls on a wooden countertop containing brown sugar, granulated sugar, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, half‑and‑half and 2 % milk. She places fresh croissants in a pan, toasts them until golden and crisp, and cuts them into cubes. While the croissants toast, she pours milk into a stainless‑steel pot on the stove, adds the condensed milk, both sugars and vanilla, and whisk‑stirs the mixture as it heats. When the liquid begins to bubble, she gradually temper‑adds beaten eggs, continuing to whisk to keep the custard smooth. Once a thick vanilla custard is formed, she pours it over the toasted croissant cubes in the pan and gently mixes until the bread is evenly coated and begins to soak. The segment ends with close‑up shots of the whisk moving through the thickening custard and the mixture bubbling in the pot.

action.brief: Combine custard with toasted croissant cubes
action.detailed: She whisk‑stirs milk, condensed milk, sugars and vanilla in a pot, gradually tem­pers beaten eggs into the hot mixture, then pours the custard over the toasted croissant cubes and stirs until the pieces are fully coated.

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a person adding ingredients to a mixture of bread with milk in a large bowl, before showing the finished pastry and then a final shot of a cup of coffee. The shot of the pastry and coffee is static with a logo in the corner.

summary.brief: Chocolate croissant bread pudding is prepared, baked, and served with vanilla ice cream.
summary.detailed: The presenter whisked a custard made from milk, half‑and‑half, sweetened condensed milk, brown and white sugar, and vanilla extract, then poured it over cubed, toasted croissants and mixed until every piece was saturated. The soaked mixture was transferred to a rectangular baking dish, where chocolate chips, crushed chocolate cookies and shaved vanilla beans were scattered on the surface. After baking until the top turned golden and slightly crisp, the warm pudding was plated and a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream was placed on top. The finished dessert was shown on a white plate outdoors against a grassy background, followed by a promotional graphic featuring a coffee cup and social‑media icons.

action.detailed: Stir the custard, pour it over the cubed croissants, mix until coated, transfer the mixture to a baking dish, sprinkle chocolate chips, crushed cookie crumbs and vanilla‑bean shavings on top, bake, then top the hot pudding with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a series of still shots, taken at different intervals, which include a white cup with a latte, a close up of a bread pudding with ice cream, a tray of chopped bread, and an array of ingredients displayed. The video pans to show the ingredients at the final scene.

summary.brief: Title cards introduce “Chocolate Croissant” and “Bread Pudding,” followed by still shots of coffee, an ice‑cream‑topped cream puff, toasted bread pieces, bagels, a chocolate croissant with vanilla ice cream, chopped bread cubes, and a tabletop spread of ingredient bowls where milk is poured.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a black screen that displays the words “CHOCOLATE CROISSANT,” which then fades to a grey screen showing “BREAD PUDDING” over a coffee cup. A quick collage follows: a coffee cup on a saucer, a cream puff topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, several pieces of bread toasting on a stovetop, and two bagels stacked on a countertop. A close‑up then shows a chocolate croissant on a white plate topped with vanilla ice cream, cut to a tin of chopped bread, and a brief view of a plate of food and sliced bread in a pan. The screen shows a chocolate brownie with vanilla ice cream and a pan filled with baked bread cubes, after which the camera lingers on many small toasted bread cubes arranged on a baking sheet. The view pans right to reveal four small glass bowls containing a brown liquid, white granulated sugar, a reddish liquid and a light‑brown liquid, with a pot half‑filled with liquid and the top of an oven rack in the background. A hand lifts one of the bowls slightly, then a milk jug is tipped to pour milk into a bowl while a finger pushes another ingredient into the same bowl. The segment concludes with the arranged bowls—showing brown sugar, salt, vanilla, milk and red wine—overlaid with a transparent circle, and a hand pouring milk from a glass into a silver bowl.

action.detailed: Tilt the milk jug and pour the milk into the small glass bowl while a finger presses another ingredient into the bowl.

nodes.plm_action: Make the syrup with the remaining ingredients, letting it boil for about 10 minutes.
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a person putting milk into a stock pot and then mixing it with butter, cinnamon, sugar, eggs and croutons.
The video shows a person tilting a glass measuring cup and pouring its white liquid into a silver pot. Then they tilt another, taller measuring cup and pour the brown liquid from it. They tilt a third, smaller measuring cup and pour its white contents. Then they pour the brown liquid from a bowl before they tilt a glass bowl and pour yellow liquid. They then stir the mixture with a whisk and later they drop a crouton into the mixture with their right hand. Then, they whisk the mixture again.

It is difficult to make out the details of the stock pot due to the lighting and camera angle.

summary.brief: The host pours milk, condensed milk and egg into a pot, whiskes a custard, then folds in cubed croissant pieces.
summary.detailed: A hand tilts a glass measuring cup to pour white milk into a stainless‑steel pot on the stove, followed by a taller cup of brown condensed milk, then a smaller cup of additional white liquid, and finally a bowl of yellow egg mixture. The liquids are whisked together, creating a smooth, bubbling custard. After the custard is well combined, the host drops cubed croissant (crouton) pieces into the pot and gives the mixture a final whisk to coat the bread cubes evenly.

action.brief: Mix custard and add croissant pieces
action.detailed: Pour the milks and egg into the heated pot, whisk continuously until a smooth custard forms, then drop the cubed croissant pieces into the pot and whisk again to coat them evenly.
action.actor: The video host, a person using both hands to pour the liquids and whisk the mixture.

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a close up of a whisk stirring a bowl of milk and cream.  The liquid is stirred and poured over the top of small pieces of bread.  The bread and milk mixture is spooned into a rectangular baking dish.  Chocolate chips and crushed cookies are sprinkled on top of the bread.  We see the back of an ice cream container before it is opened.  A dessert is served, a couple of scoops of ice cream on top.

summary.brief: A hand mixes a white custard, coats cubed croissants with it, layers the mixture in a baking dish, sprinkles chocolate chips and cookie crumbs, and finishes the pudding with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of a whisk rapidly beating a white milk‑and‑cream custard in a bowl. The hot liquid is poured over a bowl of small cubed croissant pieces, and the hand folds the mixture until every piece is fully saturated. The soaked croissant‑custard blend is then spooned into a rectangular baking dish. Dark chocolate chips and crushed chocolate‑cookie crumbs are scattered evenly over the surface. A container of vanilla ice cream is turned toward the camera, the lid is removed, and a generous scoop of the ice cream is placed on top of the warm, chocolate‑topped pudding. The final shot shows the completed dessert on a white plate against an outdoor, grassy backdrop.

action.brief: Assemble chocolate‑topped croissant bread pudding and add ice cream
action.detailed: Stir the custard with a whisk, pour it over the cubed croissants, fold to coat, transfer the mixture into a rectangular baking dish, sprinkle chocolate chips and crushed cookie crumbs on the surface, then place a scoop of vanilla ice cream on the warm pudding.
action.actor: A woman’s hand (light‑pink nails visible) performs the mixing, pouring, sprinkling, and serving steps.

nodes.plm_caption: A close-up of some food. Outside is visible in the background of the video.

summary.brief: A close‑up of a dark chocolate‑topped dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream outdoors, followed by an end‑screen showing a coffee cup and subscribe graphics.
summary.detailed: The camera stays fixed on a white plate placed on a grassy lawn, showing a dark brown, chocolate‑glazed pastry (resembling the baked bread pudding) with a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. The ice cream is smooth and begins to soften, slowly melting and dripping over the dessert while the blurred background reveals trees and grass. After a few seconds the image fades to an end‑screen that displays a white cup of coffee with latte art on a blue saucer, accompanied by “Subscribe & Follow” text and icons for Instagram, YouTube and WordPress.

action.detailed: N/A

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a still shot collage of 4 separate video clips with some text in between them that read "CHOCOLATE Croissant", "BREAD PUDDING". First clip shows a cup of coffee. Second a cream puff with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. Third a shot of 4 different pieces of bread being toasted on a stove top. Fourth a bagel and plain cheddar bagel placed on top of another bagel on a countertop. The video is a little shaky.

summary.brief: A quick collage shows a coffee cup, a chocolate croissant topped with vanilla ice cream, and close‑ups of bread pudding and toasted bread cubes that are later heated on a stove.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with black‑screen text that reads “CHOCOLATE CROISSANT” followed by gray‑screen text “BREAD PUDDING.” A coffee cup on a saucer appears, then a chocolate croissant is shown on a white plate with a large scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. The view shifts to a close‑up of chopped bread in a tin, followed by a slice of bread pudding topped with ice cream and a chocolate brownie also crowned with vanilla ice cream. A pan of baked bread is shown briefly. The footage then focuses on a dark‑gray baking sheet filled with many small, uniformly cut bread cubes; the camera zooms in on the pale, dry‑looking pieces. The bread cubes remain static, and the final seconds show the cubed bread in a pan on a stove being heated while a voice‑over plays.

action.detailed: Heat the cubed bread in a pan on the stove until the pieces turn light golden‑brown, indicating they are toasted.

nodes.plm_caption:
The camera pans to the right and shows four bowls with ingredients in them; one with a brown liquid, one with white granulated sugar, another with a reddish liquid, and the last with a light brown color.
The video cuts to a pot half full of liquid.
In the background, we can see the top of an oven rack. The wooden table is also in the background.

summary.brief: Several ingredient bowls are displayed on a wooden counter while a hand pours milk into one of them beside a simmering pot.
summary.detailed: The camera pans right across a wooden countertop, revealing four clear glass bowls that hold a brown liquid, white granulated sugar, a reddish liquid, and a light‑brown (tan) liquid; a brief "Baked with Love" graphic and a French‑bread photo appear on the screen and the top of an oven rack is visible in the background. The view then cuts to a metal pot that is half‑filled with a simmering liquid. An overhead shot follows, showing five small bowls arranged around the pot, each containing different powders or sauces. A hand enters the frame, lifts one bowl slightly, casting a shadow, and then tilts a milk jug, pouring milk into one of the bowls while the liquid in the pot gently ripples from heat.

action.detailed: The cook tilts a milk jug and lets the milk flow into a small glass bowl placed on the wooden surface.

nodes.plm_caption:
A high-speed video of a stainless pot being used to make a bechamel sauce and mixed with cubed garlic bread and eggs. The sauce is in a stainless pot, and the ingredients are poured one after another as they are added, the egg is poured after the bread. The scene is sped up to show the entire process in seconds.
The video begins with the stainless pot filled with milk, then milk and water are poured from a measuring cup into the pot. Then the cup containing coffee grounds is poured into the pot. Then vanilla syrup, salt, and a pinch of nutmeg are poured in before beginning to stir. The hand whisker moves rapidly, stirring the mixture, then the video slows down to show the cubed bread being picked and dropped into the pot with the sauce. Finally, the video speeds up again as eggs are poured into the pot and stirred with the whisker.
The stainless pot on the stove provides a background that's visible throughout the entire video.
The video is sped up to show the process in a single action.

summary.brief: A milk‑based mixture is whisked, flavored, then combined with cubed bread and beaten egg in a stainless‑steel pot.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a stainless‑steel pot on a burner that already contains milk. A hand adds more milk and water from a measuring cup, then pours in coffee grounds followed by vanilla syrup, a pinch of salt and nutmeg. While the liquid is whisked rapidly, it begins to bubble. The camera slows as the hand picks up cubed pieces of bread and drops them into the simmering mixture, stirring them in. The speed then returns as a yellow, egg‑like liquid is poured into the pot and whisked until the bread and egg are fully incorporated into the creamy sauce.

action.brief: Combine sauce with bread and egg
action.detailed: Whisk the milk mixture while gradually adding cubed bread pieces, then pour beaten egg into the pot and continue whisking until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
action.actor: A person's hands holding a whisk and pouring containers

nodes.plm_action: Stir with a large spoon or spatula as you pour the potatos.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features a pot being filled with a large saucepan which has white ingredients. A person stirs the mixture with a whisk. The video starts by focusing on the pot and the movement of the whisk. At the end, it pans to an extreme closeup before pulling away.

summary.brief: A hand whiskes a thick white mixture in a saucepan, then a spoon lifts the bubbling liquid.
summary.detailed: The camera stays focused on a silver saucepan on the stove, which is about three‑quarters full of a thick opaque white liquid; a wooden‑handled whisk is held and moved in circular motions—first clockwise, then counter‑clockwise—creating a whirlpool that turns the mixture frothy, and as the liquid begins to boil a spoon is introduced, dipping into the bubbling mixture and scooping a layer out of the pot before the shot ends.

action.detailed: Hold the whisk and move it in circular motions to aerate the thick white liquid in the saucepan until it becomes frothy, then dip a spoon into the bubbling mixture and lift a layer out of the pot.

nodes.plm_action: Assemble the cakes and their bases.
nodes.plm_caption:
A close-up shot of a bowl of white liquid. The liquid is stirred with a metal whisk, and then it splashes into a ceramic bowl containing small, cut-up pieces of bread (croissants?).
It shows a scene of someone pouring the liquid into the bowl of croissants, and then a hand moving the croissants around and around.
The top shows a bowl of chocolate being held and poured onto the casserole, and a final scene of the completed dessert.

summary.brief: A whisked white custard is poured over cubed croissants, mixed, and finished with chocolate and vanilla‑bean garnish.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a metal whisk stirring a white custard in a bowl. The custard is then poured into a white, wavy‑rimmed ceramic bowl that holds small cubed croissant pieces, and the hand moves the pieces around until they are fully coated. A clear bowl of chocolate shavings or chopped chocolate is lifted and tipped, scattering chocolate over the mixture. Next, a hand sprinkles vanilla beans (and a few additional chocolate chips) onto the surface. The camera pulls back to reveal the completed layered dessert in a rectangular baking dish, topped with chocolate chips and a dusting of cocoa powder, ready to serve.

action.brief: Mix custard‑coated croissant pieces and add chocolate and vanilla‑bean toppings
action.detailed: Whisk the white custard, pour it over the cubed croissant pieces in the ceramic bowl, stir until the pieces are evenly coated, then tip a bowl of chocolate shavings over the mixture and sprinkle vanilla beans and a small amount of chocolate chips on top.
action.actor: A woman's right hand, wearing light‑pink/purple nail polish, handling the whisk, the pouring container, and the chocolate bowl

nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a dish with a topping of dark chocolate chips. There is a container of ice cream with the label showing the contents and ingredients. The video also shows the finished product, a slice of food topped with ice cream.
The ice cream container is being turned and has colorful images on the sides and white letters that read " High road Nilla ice cream". There are ingredients and nutrition labels. The side of the container says " High road 16% Nilla Ice cream Fleur de sel 1 pint 473 ml"

A square white plate has a slice of food on it. The food is a cream and brown pastry with a chocolate topping with dark chocolate chips. There is another piece of food on the plate, the same type. Then a scoop of white ice cream is placed on top of the food.

summary.brief: Vanilla ice cream is placed on a chocolate‑chip‑topped slice of bread pudding.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of a vanilla ice‑cream tub, showing its colorful label and nutrition facts as a hand removes the lid and tilts the container. The camera then pans to a rectangular baking pan filled with a custard‑like filling that is sprinkled with dark chocolate chips and crumbs of crushed chocolate cookies. A slice of this chocolate‑topped bread pudding is set on a white square plate against a blurred outdoor background of grass and trees. Finally, a scoop of the vanilla ice cream is added on top of the slice, completing the dessert presentation.

action.detailed: Place a scoop of vanilla ice cream onto the chocolate‑chip‑topped slice of bread pudding on the plate.
action.actor: a person (the presenter) holding the ice‑cream container

nodes.plm_caption: A close-up shot of a desert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. The background is blurry and shows trees and grass and then an end title screen.

summary.brief: A close‑up of a dark chocolate‑y dessert topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream is shown outdoors before the video fades to an end‑screen with branding.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with an extreme close‑up of a plated dessert on a white plate. The dessert is dark brown, resembling a caramelized bread pudding or brownie, and a generous round of smooth white vanilla ice cream sits on top. The ice cream begins to melt, with a few droplets trickling onto the warm surface. The background is shallow‑focus outdoor scenery—green grass, trees, and a fence—illuminated by bright daylight. A fork briefly enters the frame from the right and then moves out while the camera lingers in slow motion, highlighting the glossy ice‑cream texture and crumbly pastry. After several seconds the view transitions to an end‑card that shows a white coffee cup on a blue saucer placed on a wooden surface, along with “subscribe” text, social‑media icons (Instagram, YouTube) and a website URL, before the video concludes.

A video of a chocolate croissant baking and then being shown on a white plate topped with vanilla ice cream. It cuts to cubes of bread. It starts with the words "chocolate croissant" on a black and grey background. It then shows a photo of "bread pudding." It cuts to the finished product of chocolate croissant on a white plate with a large scoop of vanilla ice cream on top of it. It cuts to a closeup of the chopped up bread in a tin. summary_sent_to_llm.title: Chocolate Croissant Bread Pudding
summary_sent_to_llm.description:
Listening to Jimmy Buffett while I cook is part time of my daily routine, so when I heard that the Margaritaville cookbook was getting released, I was so excited! Each page is filled with everyday recipes (Gazpacho video coming up next) but my favorite series far is definitely this rich bread pudding. 

This recipe is from my latest favorite cookbook “Margaritaville” check out the recipe here: https://coffeebreakxo.com/2018/06/09/chocolate-croissant-bread-pudding/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coffeebreakxo/
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with a collage of ingredient shots and text introducing chocolate croissant bread pudding. Fresh chocolate croissants are toasted until crisp while a custard is prepared by whisking together brown sugar, sweetened condensed milk, granulated sugar, half‑and‑half, 2 % milk and vanilla; the mixture is heated and the eggs are tempered in a little at a time. The warm custard is poured over the toasted croissant cubes placed in a rectangular baking dish, ensuring every piece is coated. Layers of chopped dark chocolate, chocolate chips and crushed chocolate cookies are sprinkled between the custard‑soaked croissants. The dish is baked at 300 °F for about 40 minutes, then allowed to cool briefly. A generous scoop of vanilla ice cream is placed on each serving, and the finished dessert is shown on a white plate against an outdoor background of grass and trees before ending with a promotional coffee‑and‑social‑media screen.
action_list: Combine custard with toasted croissant cubes
Mix custard and add croissant pieces
Assemble chocolate‑topped croissant bread pudding and add ice cream
Combine sauce with bread and egg
Mix custard‑coated croissant pieces and add chocolate and vanilla‑bean toppings
Whisk mixture, add bread, pour yellow liquid
Coat bread with sauce and sprinkle chocolate
Add sugars and vanilla to hot milk and whisk
Add brown granules and white powder to boiling milk
Hold and tilt ice cream container
